newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Nestle, bank lead Abidjan bourse higher in week.
newsitem.headline: Nestle, bank lead Abidjan bourse higher in week.

text.p: Share indices on Ivory Coast's stock exchange, the Bourse des Valeurs d'Abidjan (BVA), rose slightly in the week to Friday, its market report showed.
The BVA All-Share Index gained 0.51 percent to close at 365.54 points, up from last week's 363.68 points, taking the 1996 rise to 31.84 percent.
The "12 VB" blue chips index rose 0.96 percent to close at 249.26 points, up from 246.89 points last week -- a 1996 cumulative rise of 25.09 percent.
Turnover rose to 130,555,000 CFA francs from 100,325,000 CFA francs, partly because higher unit value shares were traded. A total of 5,741 shares changed hands compared to 5,390.
Nestle-CI (+2,050 at 50,600 CFA) and bank BICICI (+1,560 at 30,710 CFA) were the main risers.
Electricity company CIE (-2,490 to 14,960) led the fallers after giving investors one free share for every six held.
